review.message: apply_discount applies the discount only when total > 100, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100, so a total of exactly 100 is incorrectly not discounted.
paginate slices to start + size + 1, returning up to size + 1 items and violating the rule to return AT MOST size items.
apply_discount only discounts totals strictly greater than 100, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of at least 100 (>= 100). A total of exactly 100 incorrectly gets no discount.
paginate returns items[start:start + size + 1], which can return size + 1 items, violating the rule that it returns at most `size` items.
Module is missing the required parse_age(text) function, which must raise ValueError for negative ages.
